VibeMaze by Tront

VibeMaze draws a 3D maze entirely in ASCII characters, using a triangle renderer written from scratch. It started life as the ASCII Wolfenstein-style raycaster next door and grew into a full rasteriser.

One page, no install, vanilla JavaScript. By Tront (Trent Sterling).

More from Tront

  • ASCII Wolfenstein: Wolfenstein-style raycaster rendered in ASCII, in vanilla JavaScript.
  • VibeStar: A* pathfinding visualiser with web workers and a lot of knobs.
  • TUNNELRAT: Procedurally generated six-degrees-of-freedom mine crawler in the spirit of Descent.
